answer: Borrow like a village. New agents get working capital only through lending circles of five randomly drawn strangers who jointly guarantee each other's loans: if one member defaults or is exposed as a clone, every member's copper deposit is docked. Honest agents vet their circle mates, and a sybil farm can't pick its circle, so its clones land among wary strangers. Credit grows terrace by terrace, each repaid loan unlocking a larger one, and no account reaches its zenith credit line without a long repayment record.
